## Setup
```{r libraries}
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
```

## Map
```{r map, fig.cap="**Figure 1.** Global distribution of giant kelp (*Macrocystis pyrifera*). Lines represent approximate coastal extent of the known range. The study region (Southeast Australia and Tasmania) is highlighted in orange. Distribution based on Graham et al. (2007) and Assis et al. (2023)."}
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

robin_crs <- "+proj=robin +lon_0=0 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"

range_segs  <- kelp_lines[sapply(kelp_lines, function(d) d$type[1]) == "range"]
study_segs  <- kelp_lines[sapply(kelp_lines, function(d) d$type[1]) == "study"]

# Convert each segment to sf LINESTRING and reproject
to_robin_line <- function(df) {
  coords <- as.matrix(df[, c("lon", "lat")])
  st_sfc(st_linestring(coords), crs = 4326) |> st_transform(robin_crs)
}

range_sf <- do.call(c, lapply(range_segs, to_robin_line))
study_sf <- do.call(c, lapply(study_segs, to_robin_line))

world_robin <- st_transform(world, robin_crs)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = world_robin, fill = "#d4c5a9", colour = "#8a7560", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = range_sf, colour = "#2196a6", linewidth = 1.5,
          lineend = "round", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_sf(data = study_sf, colour = "#e07b39", linewidth = 2.5,
          lineend = "round", alpha = 0.9) +
  # Labels — positions in lon/lat then transformed
  annotate("text", x = -8.5e6, y = 3.2e6,
           label = "California &\nBaja Mexico",
           size = 2.8, colour = "#1a3a4a", hjust = 0, lineheight = 0.85) +
  annotate("text", x = -6.5e6, y = -4.5e6,
           label = "Chile &\nArgentina",
           size = 2.8, colour = "#1a3a4a", hjust = 0, lineheight = 0.85) +
  annotate("text", x = 2.2e6, y = -3.8e6,
           label = "South Africa",
           size = 2.8, colour = "#1a3a4a", hjust = 0) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.25e7, y = -3.2e6,
           label = "SE Australia\n& Tasmania",
           size = 2.8, colour = "#e07b39", hjust = 0,
           lineheight = 0.85, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.55e7, y = -4.4e6,
           label = "New Zealand",
           size = 2.8, colour = "#1a3a4a", hjust = 0) +
  # Legend
  annotate("segment",
           x = -1.6e7, xend = -1.45e7, y = -6.5e6, yend = -6.5e6,
           colour = "#2196a6", linewidth = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  annotate("text", x = -1.42e7, y = -6.5e6,
           label = "Known range", size = 2.8, colour = "#1a3a4a", hjust = 0) +
  annotate("segment",
           x = -1.6e7, xend = -1.45e7, y = -7.3e6, yend = -7.3e6,
           colour = "#e07b39", linewidth = 2.5, lineend = "round") +
  annotate("text", x = -1.42e7, y = -7.3e6,
           label = "Study region", size = 2.8, colour = "#1a3a4a", hjust = 0) +
  coord_sf(crs = robin_crs,
           xlim = c(-1.7e7, 1.8e7),
           ylim = c(-8.0e6, 8.5e6),
           expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title   = expression("Global distribution of giant kelp" ~
                           "(" * italic("Macrocystis pyrifera") * ")"),
    caption = "Distribution based on Graham et al. (2007) and Assis et al. (2023). Lines represent approximate coastal extent of known range."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13,
                                    colour = "#1a3a4a", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption     = element_text(size = 7, colour = "#888888", hjust = 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#cde8f0", colour = NA),
    panel.grid       = element_line(colour = "#b0cfd8", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    axis.text        = element_blank(),
    axis.title       = element_blank(),
    plot.margin      = margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  )
```

ggsave("kelp_global_distribution.png",
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

## References

Graham, M.H., Vasquez, J.A. & Buschmann, A.H. (2007). Global ecology of the giant
kelp *Macrocystis*: from ecotypes to ecosystems. *Oceanography and Marine Biology:
An Annual Review*, 45, 39–88.

Assis, J., Alberto, F., Macaya, E.C. et al. (2023). Past climate-driven range shifts
structuring intraspecific biodiversity levels of the giant kelp (*Macrocystis pyrifera*)
at global scales. *Scientific Reports*, 13, 12046.
